# References {.unnumbered}

## Where to go next

**If you read one thing**, read @hamilton2020 --- *Graph Representation
Learning*. It is short, free online, and the encoder–decoder framing in
@sec-idea is taken from it.

**For the spectral side**, @vonluxburg2007tutorial is the clearest treatment of
spectral clustering anywhere, and everything in @sec-spectral is a special case
of it.

**For the unification result** in @sec-mf, read @levy2014neural first (skip-gram
as implicit matrix factorisation) and then @qiu2018network (the graph version).
That is the pair that makes the field click.

**For graph transformers**, @rampasek2022recipe is the most practical starting
point --- it is explicitly written as a recipe, and its ablations tell you which
positional encodings actually earn their place.
